neighbours.label: a quantifier that is about to join 'thing/one/body/man' (quelque chose, every man, some thing): it predicts the -thing/-one/-body piece
fire: Je voudrais dire quelque chose avant de partir.
On the sinking ship it was every man for himself.
Il se passe quelque chose de bizarre dans la rue.
She said she wanted to buy some thing nice for the trip.
After the fire, every thing in the house was black.
Tu as vu quelque chose dans le jardin hier soir?
Once the market crashed it was every one for themselves.
Is there some body here who can help me lift this?
quiet: Je voudrais dire au revoir avant de partir.
On the sinking ship the captain stayed at his post.
Il se passe une fête bizarre dans la rue.
She said she wanted to buy a new hat for the trip.
After the fire, the kitchen in the house was black.
Tu as vu le chat dans le jardin hier soir?
Once the market crashed the banks closed for a week.
Is there a ladder here that can help me reach this?

notes: logit effect: the + pole suppresses 'thing','body','one'; the - pole fires on the quantifier that should be completed by them.
